title: [review] duty_cycle.rs: debug_assert used for input validation
description: with_duty_permille() uses debug_assert! to validate duty_permille > 0 and <= 1000. These assertions are stripped in release builds. If duty_permille = 0 is passed in release, max_tx_ms() returns 0, causing can_transmit() to always return false and permanently blocking all transmissions with no error indication. Use a runtime check or return Result to fail gracefully.
